title: •Orrimaarko
caption: •Orrimaarko (V)
game_text: Once per game, may ▲ a rifle and/or an Interrupt with “scout” in game text. Unless Undercover, while alone at an exterior site, opponent’s weapon destiny draws here are -2. Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Dresselian *scout* and resistance *leader*. Worked tirelessly to combat the subjugation of his homeworld before Bothans brought him into contact with the Alliance.
